maddeler.e:
أستفل (form VIII)
# أَسْتَفِلُ (ʔastafilu) /ʔas.ta.fi.lu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَفَلَ (istafala)
# أَسْتَفِلَ (ʔastafila) /ʔas.ta.fi.la/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَفَلَ (istafala)
# أَسْتَفِلْ (ʔastafil) /ʔas.ta.fil/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَفَلَ (istafala)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
